note: Who speaks with which voice, per provider. Edit freely; `node bake.mjs --list <provider>` prints what each provider offers.

akari.about: 17-year-old girl, third-year senpai: calm, kind, polite です/ます, quietly warm

yota.about: 16-year-old boy, same-year classmate: energetic, friendly, casual, a bit goofy

voicevox.about: Free, runs on this Mac. Each character needs its credit line, e.g. VOICEVOX:冥鳴ひまり.

elevenlabs.about: API key needed. Voice ids are chosen after --list (Japanese voices from the Voice Library work best).

gemini.about: Free-tier API key from Google AI Studio. Prebuilt voices are multilingual; the mood is steered by the prompt.

akari.direction: Speak natural standard Japanese (Tokyo accent) as a calm, kind 17-year-old girl, a polite senpai

yota.direction: Speak natural standard Japanese (Tokyo accent) as an energetic, friendly 16-year-old boy
